name: monster.balloon.automatasystem
displayName: AUTOMATA SYSTEM — Game Agent API for Unity
description: Lets an AI agent (such as Claude via MCP) read a running Unity game the way a player sees it, and play it with the same inputs. Provides the local endpoint, access gate, event ledger, screen capture and safety reflexes; each game registers its own views and commands through interfaces. Game-agnostic. Optional Sign in with ChatGPT lets an in-game AI use the player's own ChatGPT plan.

samples.description: The smallest integration: one IAgentWorld with a surface look route (scene name, camera name, objects in view). Import it, open the API from Tools/Agent API, enter Play, and hello and look answer in any scene.
